name: National Aluminium Company Limited
summary: National Aluminium Company Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of alumina and aluminum products in India and internationally. The company operates through Chemical and Aluminum segments. It offers aluminum metal products, such as ingots, alloy ingots, T-ingots, sows, billets, and wire rods; alumina and hydrate products, including calcined alumina and alumina hydrate; zeolite-A products; specialty alumina and hydrate products; and aluminum rolled and chequered sheets products. The company also owns and operates Coal Mine covering an area of 824.316 hectors situated in Chhendipada Tehsil of Angul District; an opencast mine covering an area of 16 square kilometers on Panchpatmali hills …
